gold: Leukemia cutis secondary to juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia (JMML)

selector.rationale: Perivascular and periadnexal infiltrate with positive CD4 and CD163 immunohistochemical staining supports Langerhans cell histiocytosis, which is further strengthened by the clinical presentation of annular, indurated, dusky red plaques with central clearing and trailing scale.

rejected.label: Juvenile xanthogranuloma
rejected.why: Lack of specific histopathological features and immunohistochemical staining

rejected.label: Erythema annulare centrifugum
rejected.why: Clinical presentation and histopathology do not fully align with this condition

rejected.label: Mastocytosis
rejected.why: Immunohistochemical staining pattern does not support mastocytosis
